module_summary: Valid/ready stream wrapper around a synchronous FIFO child: push and pop are gated by full and empty, which also generate ready_o and valid_o.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Input stream valid; with not-full forms the FIFO push.

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Input ready, asserted when FIFO is not full.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Input payload written into the FIFO.

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Output valid, asserted when FIFO is not empty.

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Output ready; with not-empty forms the FIFO pop.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag; blocks push and deasserts ready_o.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag; blocks pop and deasserts valid_o.

anchors.name: push
anchors.why: FIFO write enable: valid_i and not full.

anchors.name: pop
anchors.why: FIFO read enable: ready_i and not empty.

anchors.name: usage_o
anchors.why: FIFO fill level output from child.

groups.name: handshake_logic
groups.description: Converts valid/ready handshakes to FIFO push/pop using full/empty.

groups.name: fifo
groups.description: Synchronous FIFO child storing stream data.
